newsitem.title: ZAIRE: Zaire says army battling to retake Kikwit town.
newsitem.headline: Zaire says army battling to retake Kikwit town.

text.p: Zaire said on Tuesday government forces were battling to retake the western town of Kikwit and had killed several hundred rebels.
"Intense fighting is taking place. The rebels have lost 600 men," the prime minister's military adviser, Captain Aime Atembina, told a news conference in the capital Kinshasa.
He did not say when the fighting started, but added that Kikwit, 400 km (250 miles) east of Kinshasa, had never been completely taken by the rebels who announced its capture just over a week ago.
Atembina said government troops, who have lost control of most of Zaire's territory to rebels since October, would fight to prevent guerrilla leader Laurent Kabila entering Kinshasa by force.
"It will be very difficult for him," he said.
